CLINICAL AUTHORITIES.

- Sexual irritation, Moore, Times Ret., 1877, p. 35 ; M. Inv., vol. 6, p. 343 ; Seminal emissions (oil), Cushing, Times Ret., 1876, p. 113 ; Mass. Trans., vol. 4, p. 512 ; Nymphomania, Elb., A. H. MIND. [1] [Orig.]
Lascivious ideas with sexual irritation.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Orig.]
Nocturnal emissions.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Orig.]
Erotomania and inclination to suicide in a young girl ; great sexual irritation ; deep moroseness, believes herself lost and despised ; when awaking from her stupor cries out that the devil comes near her, believes herself in hell, in chains, considered herself crazy, and those about her feared that she would become so ; has thoughts of destroying herself.
Great sexual excitement driving her to onanism, a day scarcely passing without her indulging in this habit ; whenever she meets a man whose appearance is pleasing she is at once driven to commit masturbation.
After having practiced masturbation for a long time became nearly idiotic ; was not able to learn her catechism (with Sulph).
Abused herself daily ; tried her utmost to overcome sexual inclinations and vainly gave herself up to religious exercises in order to strengthen her will.
Sexual irritation with leucorrhœa and itching of pudenda, in an old maid, æt. 40.
Powerful lascivious impulses, producing anxiety, from disinclination to religious duties ; leucorrhœa ; a worthy married woman and mother of a family.
Sexual irritation in a divorced woman ; had neither rest nor quiet from voluptuousness.
Leucorrhœa, sterility, "flatulency of uterus."
   

NERVES. [36] [Orig.]
Hysteria from excessive irritation of genitals.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Orig.]
Lascivious ideas and dreams.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Orig.]
Girl, æt. 7 ; onanism.
Girl, æt. 17, daughter of silk weaver ; onanism and mental weakness.
Girl, æt. 20, well every other way ; sexual irritation and onanism.
Woman, æt. 29, single, teacher of languages, suffering four years, never had coitus ; nymphomania.
Woman, æt. 35, married, mother of a family, suffering several months ; leucorrhœa and sexual irritation.
Old maid, æt. 40 ; sexual irritation with leucorrhœa.
Woman, divorced ; sexual irritation.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Orig.]
Compare : Canthar., Cann. ind., Collinson., Hedeoma, Helon., Platin., Valeriana.
